description: This file defines classes and methods for managing server-side Spark Connect listeners, including a holder for the listener resources and a custom streaming query listener that serializes events to JSON and sends them to clients via gRPC StreamObserver.

classes.name: ServerSideListenerHolder
classes.description: Holds server-side listener resources, manages initialization and cleanup of the SparkConnectListenerBusListener, and caches query start events.

classes.name: SparkConnectListenerBusListener
classes.description: A custom StreamingQueryListener that serializes events to JSON and streams them to clients via gRPC, handling exceptions and listener cleanup.

methods.name: isServerSideListenerRegistered
methods.description: Checks if the server-side listener is registered.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the server-side listener and attaches it to the session streams.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Removes the listener, clears caches, and sends final response.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Serializes an event to JSON and sends it to the client via responseObserver.

methods.name: sendResultComplete
methods.description: Sends a completion signal to the client.

methods.name: onQueryStarted
methods.description: Caches the QueryStartedEvent for later use.

methods.name: onQueryProgress
methods.description: Serializes and sends a QueryProgressEvent to the client.

methods.name: onQueryTerminated
methods.description: Serializes and sends a QueryTerminatedEvent to the client.

methods.name: onQueryIdle
methods.description: Serializes and sends a QueryIdleEvent to the client.
